title: Thai Airways reports unauthorized access to passenger records

blocks.text: Thai Airways International has disclosed a potential data breach involving more than 60,000 passenger records after its passenger service system provider, Amadeus IT Group S.A., reported a cybersecurity incident. In a statement on Monday (Nov. 9, 2026), the airline said the incident involved unauthorized access to booking data stored in Amadeus’ system from Aug. 10, 2023, to Sept. 23, 2026. Initial checks indicated that approximately 60,529 passenger records may have been affected. The information potentially accessed included passenger names, booking reference numbers (PNRs), travel dates, flight routes and cabin classes.
